Brussels Travel Guide

Why choose Brussels

Brussels combines ornate guildhall architecture with Art Nouveau heritage and European institutions.

Build a short break around Grand-Place and Atomium. Use the official visitor guide below to check the exact locations and opening arrangements before grouping them into a day.

Shape the day

Grand-Place

Make this the anchor of your first day, with time for the surrounding streets and a meal. Check whether your chosen experience needs a timed ticket.

Atomium

Save a separate block for this part of Brussels. Compare the route from your base before deciding whether to walk or take local transport.

Choose a base

For a first visit to Brussels, compare accommodation near your arrival point with options closer to Grand-Place. Check the actual walking route, luggage access and evening journey rather than relying on map distance alone.

Compare the full stay price and cancellation terms. A central address can reduce daily transfers, but check street noise and accessibility for the individual property.

A simple first plan

  • Arrival: settle in and take a short orientation walk.
  • First full day: allow time for Grand-Place and a nearby meal.
  • Next block: explore Atomium, leaving room for weather or a slower start.

Bruges canal cruises depend on seasonal schedules, weather and demand; confirm operation for your visit. Museum-led breaks offer an alternative to outdoor plans.
